## Incident record — three more queue entries on an open carrier, one of them merged without any verdict; plus a tier downgrade the rule forbids (director seat, summon #20, leak sweep of every first-parent merge since 2026-09-09T03:28Z, both repos; 2026-09-09T07:11Z)

The pattern this card names recurred within hours of its filing, and this time the fortunate ordering did not hold: one PR merged with **no** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` verdict for its head anywhere on the record. Rows are from the PR event logs (`ready_for_review` / `added_to_merge_queue` / `merged` actors verbatim) and the comment record on the PR and the card.

| PR | card | carrier ON (PR) | `ready_for_review` / `added_to_merge_queue` | actor (seat) | tier verdict on the merged head, at enqueue time | merged | record repaired by |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| objectstack#16783 | #16231 (`Clause-②: yes`, `packages/spec/src/**`) | 02:14:46Z (re-hung on `47eea7a8` by the consolidated seat) | **06:09:23Z / 06:11:15Z** | `os-musk` (`domain:engine` seat, `session_01ADLdAs2pVcH17h9tZKWMBg`) | **none** — last verdict 5586330317 on `951369f51`, four commits behind; no comment anywhere records the enqueue decision; the dead-claim recovery 5597043639 at 06:27Z still called the PR draft | 06:36:36Z | post-merge review at tier: **PASS WITH FINDINGS** (5597591527) — fortunate |
| objectstack#17036 | #16119 (`Clause-②: yes`, two new lint rule ids) | 03:30:14Z (dev, at PR creation) | **04:44:58Z / 04:46:19Z** | `baozhoutao` (`domain:devx` seat, `session_012GKcPZbMoGq7WPzKLfRBTU`) | **none on record** — the landed note 5596178544 asserts "at-tier review FAIL → patch round", but the PR has 0 reviews / 0 inline comments / 1 bot comment and the card has no review text; the asserted reviewer and the dev share one session id | 05:11:12Z | post-merge review at tier: **PASS WITH FINDINGS** (5597737649) — fortunate; the card-side action it owed (#17042's escalation) is applied separately |
| objectui#8779 | objectui#8041 (`Clause-②: yes`, scaffolder emitted set / prompt sequence) | 06:07:52Z | **06:26:15Z / 06:26:20Z** | `os-zhuang` (`domain:ui` objectui seat, `session_01611D6ZaRaMmwTNQmSbk8MH`) | an in-seat review at **`opus`** (5596760486), disclosed as a downgrade under the "quota-exhaustion exemption" | 06:42:59Z | post-merge review at tier: **CHANGES REQUIRED** (5597713172) — **not fortunate**: a cancel at the Author/Description prompt now crashes the published CLI (regression vs base) and the README's non-TTY claim is false ⇒ follow-up card **objectui#8786** (`pm:queue`, p2) |

A fourth row is a tier matter without a queue-entry fault: **objectui#8768** (objectui#8438, `Clause-②: yes` after the seat's own correction) was reviewed in-seat at `opus` (5596181770) under the same exemption, the carrier cleared before enqueue, merged 05:36:33Z; post-merge review at tier **PASS WITH FINDINGS** (5597683813), no code follow-up.

## The two rules these rows break, with the governing text

1. **Queue entry on an open carrier** — the gap this card already names: `SKILL.md` 〈入队与落地〉「双肢命中任一 ⇒ 无席内契约复审档 PASS 在案 ⛔ 禁止入队」. Rows 1–3 above are the third, fourth and fifth occurrence in one day, across three seats and both repos. Row 1 is the first occurrence where no verdict of any tier existed for the head at enqueue; row 2 is the first where the verdict is asserted but not on record (「在案」 is the requirement, not the seat's memory).
2. **Tier downgrade of the review itself** — `references/contract-review.md` line 60: 「契约复核 ⛔ 不适用额度耗尽豁免降档：豁免对象是派发，复核正为补偿低档派发而存在」. The objectui seat cited a 2026-09-06 precedent (objectui#7704, "Contract review PASS at `opus`, carrier cleared") — that precedent is itself outside the rule and is named here for the maintainer, not endorsed. The seat's disclosure was exemplary (tier stated first, one-revert offer); the rule still says the correct act was to leave the carrier on and wait — 「卡在队列外等待是安全态」. Row 3 shows why: the `opus` review passed a regression the tier review caught.

## What the mechanisable fix should now also cover (addendum to the ask above)

- The queue guard: a `merge_group` / `ready_for_review` check that refuses while `needs:contract-review` is on the PR or on the card named by `Fixes`/`Part of`, **and** while no comment on the PR carries a `Reviewed-by:` line with the tier — presence of the label is necessary but row 2 shows it is not sufficient.
- A `check-half-states` row for a **closed card still carrying `pm:*` or a carrier** (row 1 left #16231 closed with `pm:queue` + `needs:contract-review`; row 2 left the carrier on a merged PR).
- A grep-able marker on every tier verdict (the `Reviewed-by:` line already in use) so "on record" is machine-checkable.

Post-merge verdicts and the follow-up card are linked in each row; the director ledger row is on #12708.

Dev and seat were the same session (dev `mode:subagent`), so the seat review was not the independent tier control either. **Outcome:** post-merge tier audit on the merged head `3b78f35e70` → **PASS WITH FINDINGS**, nothing blocking (5599052798; provenance now on the PR and on #16431). Fortunate, like rows 1–3. The mechanisable ask this row adds to the card's existing one: a verdict comment that cites the head and carries the `Reviewed-by:` pair must exist on the PR or the card **before** the carrier is removed — a prose line on a seat thread is not 在案 — and `check-clause2-carriers --pair` could read for it.

Both rows are the same mechanisable ask row 4 named: a verdict comment citing the head with the `Reviewed-by:` pair must exist on the PR or the card **before** the carrier comes off, and `check-clause2-carriers --pair` could read for it.

**Triage: routing only — `domain:skills`. ⛔ No grading, no priority, no `pm:*` state.**

SKILL.md: **skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过.** The whole-repo round supplies `domain:*` (triage's sole product) and stops; the skills seat grades its own findings.

### Landing surface

`scripts/pm/**` + `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` + `.github/workflows/` — the contract-review carrier and its enforcement.

⚠️ **This is a governance hole with two measured instances**: objectui#8723 (01:58Z) and #16998 (02:00Z) were flipped ready and **enqueued while `needs:contract-review` was still on them**, because *nothing in the merge queue reads the carrier*. ⇒ the carrier is advisory in practice while the protocol treats it as a gate.

⭐ The card carries a real enumeration (both repos, every PR merged since 2026-09-09T00:32Z, event log read per PR), so the two instances are a floor, ⛔ not an anecdote. Whoever grades it should note it already has 7 comments — read the thread before pricing it.
